text_block_list.text:
When I went to the library,
Ikuno Dictus was there with a troubled look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's quite difficult, isn't it?
—Raising a child, that is.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just thinking of a reply
to some advice asked in a fan letter.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I tried answering a small question from a fan letter once.
And as I kept doing that—
choice_data_list: So it's turning into an advice column letter, huh?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: It brings me great joy to be of help to all of you who support me so faithfully.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However...
If it were 'tips on running' or 'how to make up with friends,'
that would be one thing, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: When it comes to parenting topics, like, "Ever since the new baby was born, my older child won't listen to me anymore"...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Treating a baby and the other siblings equally is difficult.
Having a big family myself, I understand completely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "However, I do not understand the psychology of young children. Even after researching it like this, I have made no progress whatsoever..."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... Even though you came to me for advice,
I can't just give you inaccurate information—"
choice_data_list: I think you should just go with whatever answer you think is best, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: I think she came to you for advice because she wanted to ask you, Ikuno.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My gratitude to you, Trainer.
I was about to lose sight of my original feelings.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: As an older sister with younger siblings, I think I'll try putting my thoughts into writing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Please, make sure to hold the older child gently in your arms.
I am sure... just like I did when I was young,
they will feel your love and trust."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...All right, that should do it.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, I kept you waiting for lights-out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, not at all. You looked so earnest
that I couldn't help but be captivated.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you very much.
I'm truly humbled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...
To answer the fans' hopes, and reward them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Whether it is running, singing, or writing a letter,
I do not believe their true essence differs all that much.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I hope I can be of help to you.
...For as long as possible, in as many ways as possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, Ikuno-san.
Yes, I am certain of it.
